papers.title: Cognitive Dual-Process Planning for Autonomous Driving with Structured Scene Knowledge and Verifiable Reasoning-Action Consistency
papers.authors: Zhongyao Yang, Haoyu Li, Yu Yan et al.
papers.summary: 认知双过程规划框架（模拟人类快慢思考）：快速直觉路径（routine场景端到端轨迹预测）+ 慢速推理路径（VLM结构化场景知识+可验证推理-动作一致性检查）。提出Reason-Action Consistency (RAC)机制校验推理与动作逻辑一致性。在nuScenes+Bench2Drive上验证，复杂场景成功率+22%，推理开销降低60%

papers.title: What Do They See? Interpreting Complex Road Scenarios Through the Eyes of Vision-Language-Action Models for Safe and Trustworthy Autonomous Vehicle Learning
papers.authors: Kalpana Panda, Wesley Maia, Vinti Agarwal, Ross Greer
papers.summary: 提出CVAA反事实消融框架，通过生成式修复选择性移除场景中的个别物体，量化评估其对VLA模型规划行为的因果影响。在Alpamayo 1轨迹预测器+210个nuScenes场景上验证，构建Counter-nuScenes可解释性数据集

papers.title: WorkDrive: Roadwork Chain of Causation for Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Tianyi Jiang, Wen Zhang, Sihan Yang et al.
papers.summary: 聚焦道路施工区的VLM规划挑战。提出Chain of Causation推理方法，显式建模施工场景中临时路标/锥桶/围栏间的因果链。构建RoadWorkQA数据集（15k+施工场景QA对），在zero-shot规划任务上准确率+15%

papers.title: Instant NuRec: Feed-Forward 3D Gaussian Reconstruction for Driving Scene Simulation
papers.summary: NVIDIA提出的前馈式3D高斯场景重建方法，无需逐场景优化即可从单次前向传播重建驾驶场景。支持端到端策略评估的仿真平台构建，相比NeRF方法速度提升1000x+

papers.title: M4World: A Multi-view Multimodal Driving World Model for Interactive Object Manipulation and Minute-long Streaming
papers.authors: Ke Cheng, Hanqiao Ye, Lei Shi et al.
papers.summary: 多视角多模态驾驶世界模型：支持交互式物体操作（添加/移除/移动车辆行人）+ 分钟级长视频流稳定生成。联合合成未来环视图视频流与同步LiDAR扫描，物体级操控通过3D感知特征注入实现，长时稳定性通过时序记忆bank保障

papers.title: Cyclone: Diffusion Model for Cycle-Consistent Weather Editing from Unpaired Driving Data
papers.authors: Thang-Anh-Quan Nguyen, Moussab Bennehar, Luis Guillermo Roldao Jimenez et al.
papers.summary: 循环一致性扩散模型用于驾驶数据天气编辑（晴→雨/雪/雾），无需配对数据。Cycle-consistent训练策略保证编辑前后场景结构一致，支持感知模型鲁棒性增强训练

papers.title: Variational Inference for Bird's Eye View Segmentation in Autonomous Driving
papers.authors: Jingyue Shi, Huaicheng Li, Junhui Zhao, Yanxiang Jiang
papers.summary: 变分推断方法用于BEV分割，将多相机融合建模为概率推断问题。通过变分分布近似多视角不确定性，在nuScenes BEV分割任务上优于确定性方法

papers.title: GPOcc++: Unified Sparse Gaussian Occupancy Prediction with Visual Geometry Priors
papers.authors: Changqing Zhou, Yueru Luo, Yulan Guo et al.
papers.summary: 统一稀疏高斯3D占用预测框架，结合视觉几何先验（深度、位姿）提升遮挡区域预测质量。稀疏高斯表示避免密集体素计算浪费，在Occ3D-nuScenes上达到SOTA

papers.title: LARAD: Layout-Aware Road Anomaly Detection via Spatial-Logic Reasoning
papers.authors: Shiyi Mu, Xujie Chen, Shugong Xu
papers.summary: 布局感知的道路异常检测：利用空间逻辑推理（如'物体不应出现在车道中间'）替代纯纹理novelty检测，大幅降低OoD误报。无需级联大视觉模型，推理延迟可控

papers.title: DeGuNet: Depth-Guided Ultra-Compact Backbones for Efficient LiDAR-Camera 3D Detection
papers.authors: Haifa Zhang, Yijing Wang, Peixi Peng, Zhiqiang Zuo
papers.summary: 深度引导的超紧凑主干网络用于高效LiDAR-相机3D检测。通过深度先验压缩视觉backbone参数量，解决2D预训练主干与3D稀疏点云的结构错配问题

papers.title: ADAPT: Adaptive Cross-Modal Fusion with Sparse Attention for Pedestrian Crossing Intention Prediction
papers.authors: Md Mahfuzur Rahman, Pengzhan Zhou, A F M Abdun Noor et al.
papers.summary: 自适应域感知跨模态融合模型用于行人过街意图预测。稀疏注意力机制选择性融合视觉+运动学信息，减少冗余跨模态交互。在PIE/PJA数据集上达到SOTA

papers.title: Vision-Language Assistant for Emotional Reactions to Risky Driving
papers.authors: Harine Choi, Eun Hak Lee, Zhengzhong Tu
papers.summary: VLM驱动的危险驾驶行为检测与情感回应生成系统。检测路面风险行为并生成拟人化情感反馈，探索VLM在人机交互中的情感角色
